messages:
maria: Heads-up — after the driver rollout (NVIDIA 555.23 -> 556.11) on the H100 serving fleet, our autotuner is changing kernel preferences for long sequences (>=1024). We're seeing consistent p99 token latency regressions in the 12–18% range on rwkv/llama-like workloads. Perf CI flagged it this morning, surfacing here so infra/runtime can coordinate. Logs & micro-profiles below.

deploy-bot: driver-rollout finished for h100-zone-a; image: inference-2026.03.15, driver: 556.11.

sam_w: do we have a minimal repro and perf traces? which kernel paths changed?

maria: Minimal trace dump attached (excerpt):

```
# model=rwkv-7b, batch=8, seq=1536
# driver 555.23 (baseline)
kernel_pick: fused_attn_v2_seqopt (path_id=1)
time_per_token: 1.8 ms
# driver 556.11 (current)
kernel_pick: fused_attn_v3 (path_id=3)
time_per_token: 2.10 ms  # +16.7% per-token
# kv-cache metrics (baseline -> current): hit_rate 98.2% -> 94.1% (investigate misalignment)
```

maria: Notes from the profiler: SM occupancy reported differently on 556.11 which seems to push the autotuner's scoring toward kernels that favor larger blocks (v3). Also seeing slightly larger workspace allocation sizes which may misalign KV cache buffer offsets in our custom allocator (small bump in memcpy/pack cost).

perf-ci-bot: Nightly microbench shows deviation starting at 2026-03-15 02:10 UTC, p95/p99 deltas match report. Link: https://perf.internal/reports/1865432100

kai: Quick workaround: we can force the ranking heuristic to prefer the legacy seq-optimized kernel for long sequences until we root-cause. Example config: 

```
# runtime override (hot-reloadable)
runtime.config.kernel_override = [
  {
    "model_pattern": "*",
    "seq_threshold": 1024,
    "force_kernel": "fused_attn_v2_seqopt",
    "reason": "post-driver 556.11 regression"
  }
]
```

kai: This is cheap and reversible. It prevents fleet-wide driver pin or emergency rollback.

anya: Agree. Plan: (A) enable kernel_override on 10% canary pool, (B) monitor p99/token and KV hit-rate for 2 hours, (C) if stable, ramp to 100% over 1h. Also add a temporary autotuner weight delta: decrease score of v3 by 0.15 for seq>1024.

sam_w: What about KV cache misalignment? If workspace sizes changed, forcing kernel may just hide an underlying correctness/throughput issue. We should capture a few full-memory dumps from affected hosts.

maria: Good call. I'll collect allocator traces + cublas workspace sizes from two affected nodes (h100-04, h100-11). Also adding a check in the allocator to assert 64B alignment and log on mismatch.

maria: Proposed immediate runbook (TL;DR):
1) Push runtime.kernel_override (kai) to 10% canary in zone-a.
2) Enable autotuner weight adjustment (anya).
3) Collect allocator + KV-cache dumps (maria).
4) If metrics recover, roll override to 100% and start detailed RCA.
5) If reg persists, consider infra rollback to driver 555.23 (heavy, scheduled).

sam_w: I can script the canary rollout + alerting (p99/token, kv-hit). Will add abort thresholds (p99 > baseline+5% => rollback override).

deploy-bot: queued runtime.config update: kernel_override -> canary group 10% (pending approval).

maria: Assignments: kai -> prepare override patch and playbook; anya -> autotuner weight delta PR & monitor dashboard; sam_w -> canary automation + alert rules; i'll gather dumps and paste links.

maria: Timeline: push canary within 30m, monitor for 2h. If green, full rollout by EOD. If not, schedule driver rollback discussion with infra for immediate next maintenance window.

anya: One more note — add an evaluation job that runs a small latency-sensitive prompt set (seq mix 512/1024/1536) every 15m so we catch regressions fast.

kai: I'll also add a per-model override flag so we can restrict to models that actually hit the regression instead of global forcing.

maria: Ok pulling together PRs now. Will post allocator traces and perf links once uploaded. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
